review_method: Entire recording sampled at 1 fps; source pages compared visually; page-12 165–169s reviewed at 5 fps. Times are approximate samples, not measured tap latency.
limits: No version screen is visible; version is inferred from the delivery/feedback sequence.
Do not infer tap count, exact source coordinate or missed response from sparse samples.
Successful individual openings are not five-position certification.
No new runtime fixes or APK are claimed by this findings update.

items.target: Separate bottom-left Wolverine/planes and bottom-right searchlight panels
items.observation: Repeated overlays include both bottom panels and the divider. The right searchlight panel opens alone around 178 seconds. The middle strip opens separately at 165.6–166.2 seconds.
items.acceptance: Distinct whole-frame owners at five interior positions per bottom panel; repeat open/close on both without clearing cache; preserve middle strip and other successful page-12 frames.

items.target: Complete red bomber/action strip above the bottom Wolverine panel
items.observation: A crop emphasizes the bomber/left portion; another isolates the red right side and its caption. Neither should define a new panel inside the continuous printed strip.
items.acceptance: Same whole strip at center/left/right/north/south, including bomber, action lettering and right narration; separately verify genuine caption selection.

items.observation: Upper-left seated Wolverine and the two upper-right frames are returned together.
items.acceptance: Three separate printed frames; preserve the established lower-right pair and all successful lower panels.

items.target: Upper motorcycle and two right-hand inset/overlapping frames
items.observation: The upper group opens as one rectangle, including both right-hand images. Source artwork has staggered, overlapping frame borders; a simple shared-rail partition is not sufficient evidence.
items.acceptance: Each visible printed frame retains its actual border and stacking relationship; reject the three-frame composite; preserve lower road and headlight strips.

items.target: Top forest strip and middle portrait/fortification panels
items.observation: The pop-out includes the top strip plus both middle panels.
items.acceptance: Three separate frame owners with no cross-gutter merge; preserve the two lower strips.

items.target: Reject snowy fortification/fence artwork as a caption
items.observation: An irregular white snow region with repeated X-shaped fortifications becomes a second-level cutout without text. Local BubbleDetect.detect reproduces accepted non-text regions at four independently selected source points.
items.acceptance: Reject the snow/fence regions through detect and extract while preserving real narration, short speech and the existing page-4/page-5 caption controls.

local_snow_probe.coordinate_origin: independently chosen on original source artwork, not recovered phone touch events
